_comment: Cold-formed steel C-stud framing. Studs/tracks are picked from profiles by family + nominal depth + gauge. Tracks wrap the studs (legs outside the stud flanges). deflection_track: deep-leg top track with the studs cut deflection_gap short of its web. Bridging: cold-rolled channel through the stud knockouts every bridging_spacing (detail LOD; 0 = none). gauges: design thickness (in) for reference.

metal.label: Cold-formed steel C-studs in top and bottom track
